title: [2.7] Minor bug, DANA RS: "Pump Site Change" always logged with "Insulin Cartridge Change"
symptom: When logging an insulin cartridge change using the Prime/Fill action and ticking only 'Insulin Cartridge Change' (not 'Pump Site Change'), a 'Pump Site Change' is also logged.
cause: The thread does not identify a root cause for the Dana RS issue; it only notes a similar bug in the Insight driver.
fix: No fix is stated for the Dana RS issue. For the Insight pump, a workaround is to disable 'Log site change' in Insight preferences, but then site changes must be manually recorded in AAPS.
evidence_quote: A workaround is to disable "Log site change" in Insight preference, but it's necessary after that to always manualy record site change in AAPS even if done directly in pump...
